title: Tray manifest
description: Named shortcuts that expand to zqk argv (embedded defaults + optional .zqk/tray.yaml). This is project-local config, not a process object kind—see pkg/tray and zqk tray. Keep pkg/tray/tray_config.schema.json in sync with this file.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URL (e.g. https://zqk.dev/schemas/tray_config.schema.json) for editors and zqk validate-yaml

entries.description: Tray entries; user .zqk/tray.yaml merges by name with embedded defaults

argv.description: Arguments after the zqk binary (subcommand and flags); must not include the binary name

signed_by.description: Kernel Account ID of the author who signed this tray command

signature.description: Hex-encoded ECDSA signature over canonical JSON of name + argv
